author: More Perfect Union
description:
The walls are closing in on Kalshi and Polymarket.

They're facing dozens of lawsuits accusing them of running illegal gambling platforms.

Now, they're buying up DC insiders who can help them dodge regulation—and avoid hundreds of millions of dollars in taxes.

Producer: Trevor Hayes
Editor: David McCaw
Supervising Producer: Court Fuller
title: How Kalshi and Polymarket Captured the US Government
